title: William W. Parmley
vital_facts: Baptized as a child; Aaronic Priesthood as a youth; Melchizedek Priesthood as a young man
Missionary to the Northwestern States Mission 1957-1959
Married Shanna Lee, 1961, Salt Lake Temple; four children
Bachelor's degree in physics from Harvard; Medical degree from Johns Hopkins Medical School; Internal Medicine training from Johns Hopkins Medical School and Peter Bent Brigham Hospital
Bishop, Stake President, Area Authority Seventy, Gospel Doctrine Teacher
accuracy_caveat: Community-compiled biographies from gapages.com (offline since 2023). Recovered from the Wayback Machine. Cross-reference with official Church sources.
